parts:
Pro.Chalmers,

      Can I ignore itemfit and continue to estimate? Thank you

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I continue to estimate trait varialbe?
parts:
That's a very difficult question to answer. It depends on the degree of misfit, how many items are misfitting, the type of misfit (whether systematic or not), and so on. I wouldn't advice it in general as including misfitting items clearly violates how the model should be behaving, and obtaining factor scores and such post-estimation is highly dependent on the degree to which the model adequately reflects the data. 

Phil
